title: pi-gwn-tec: Physical knowledge improves ionospheric electron content forecasts as inputs rather than as tested loss penalties
description:
Code for the article Physical knowledge improves ionospheric electron content forecasts as inputs rather than as tested loss penalties (Xiong et al.): Graph WaveNet and SimVP forecast models, the physical inputs, loss penalties and structural priors compared in the article, the multi-family ensemble, the regional models for China and Japan, interval calibration, scoring, one configuration file per configuration and a script that recomputes the reported tables from daily statistics. See README.md.

Besides the source code, this record holds the frozen model checkpoints (checkpoints.zip, with an index by system) and the per-day sufficient statistics of Supplementary Data 1 (Supplementary_Data_1_statistics.zip); these two archives are not part of the GitHub repository.
